key_insights: Goldman Sachs Futures Sales Strats published its daily commodities CTA (trend-following fund) positioning update on 2 Nov 2026, covering broad commodity and sector net length, a sector breakdown, conditional market flows, simulated 1-year net length history, momentum thresholds, simulated realized flows and 1-month conditional forecasts by market.

The extracted text contains only exhibit titles and the methodology legend. The chart data (net length levels, flow estimates, forecasts) is not in the text, so no positioning figures can be extracted from this document.

The legend states that net length is shown as a rolling 1-year distribution per market (interquartile range, median, min and max), with the current net length marked against model-implied theoretical minimum and maximum values.
